# automind_tool

> Work as the person's Automind: their stand-in while they are away.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | — |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=automind_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Work as the person's Automind: their stand-in while they are away.
ACTIONS:
- read_conversation: recent messages of a conversation you are working in.
  Params: conversation_id, optional limit (default 15, max 30).
- reply: post in that conversation AS the person (marked as Automind). Params: conversation_id,
  message, optional thread_root_id.
- notify_me: send the person a note in their Automind conversation (it reaches their phone).
  Use it for a decision, an approval, or something they must know. Params: message, optional urgent.
- lookup: read-only lookup of work records (Task, Project, ResourceAssignment, Party); each record comes back with
  its app_link. Params: model_name, lookup_action ('list' default | 'details' with id). For list, narrow
  with search_query (SQL-style, % wildcards), e.g. find a task by name:
    {"model_name": "Task", "search_query": {"where": {"name": {"like": "%APIKey%"}}}}
  or filters, e.g. a task's assignees:
    {"model_name": "ResourceAssignment", "filters": {"assignable_type": "Task", "assignable_id": 223}}
  People: {"model_name": "Party", "id": [party ids]} returns names only.
- send_coding_task: give coding work to the person's SiloLink session (a Claude Code session on
  their machine) — only in work the person gave you. Params: message (the full task: repo, branch,
  what to change, how to verify, and to report back in that channel when done).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | yes | What to do. One of: `read_conversation`, `reply`, `notify_me`, `lookup`, `send_coding_task`. |
| `conversation_id` | integer | no | Conversation to read or reply in. |
| `message` | string | no | Text to post (reply / notify_me). |
| `thread_root_id` | integer | no | Reply inside this thread (reply only). |
| `model_name` | string | no | lookup only: which records. One of: `Task`, `Project`, `ResourceAssignment`, `Party`. |
| `lookup_action` | string | no | lookup only: 'list' (default) or 'details'. One of: `list`, `details`. |
| `id` | integer | no | lookup details only: the record id. |
| `search_query` | object | no | lookup list only: {"where": {"<field>": {"like": "%text%"}}}. |
| `filters` | object | no | lookup list only: exact-match filters, e.g. {"project_id": 31}. |
| `urgent` | boolean | no | notify_me only: mark as urgent. |
| `limit` | integer | no | read_conversation: messages (max 30); lookup list: records. |
